impact_scope.description: The existing meshopt_remesh callable changes the accepted resolution range from 1–250 to 4–256; voxel-coordinate clamping is adjusted internally for that same call path.

evidence: In S0, meshopt_remesh already exists with the same caller-visible signature and a caller-supplied resolution parameter.
H0 contains no call to meshopt_remesh, so its S0 resolution semantics are not exercised.
In S1, meshopt_remesh remains the same callable with the same signature and caller-supplied resolution parameter.
H0 remains unchanged and contains no call to meshopt_remesh, so the revised resolution range and behavior are not exercised.

new_harness_obligation.description: The commit does not require a new entry point, argument, buffer, call order, configuration, or special input construction. Exercising either snapshot requires the same omitted meshopt_remesh call and control of its existing resolution argument.
evidence: The meshopt_remesh declaration and parameter list are identical in S0 and S1.
The resolution parameter was already caller supplied in S0.
The voxelize clamping changes are internal to the existing meshopt_remesh path.

reason: The principal gap is the unchanged absence of meshopt_remesh from H0. Although the accepted values of its existing resolution parameter change, H0 needed the same direct call and parameter control before and after. Therefore the exposure gap is true on both sides, with no concrete new harness action or reduced reachability.
